title: Notifications
description: Alert delivery channels of the tenant and the history of fired alerts

breaker_opened.label: Breaker opened
breaker_opened.description: An endpoint group circuit breaker opened and stopped handing out identities.

breaker_reopened.label: Breaker reopened
breaker_reopened.description: A half-open breaker failed its probes and opened again.

breaker_closed.label: Breaker closed
breaker_closed.description: A breaker recovered and traffic resumed.

identity_low_watermark.label: Identities below low watermark
identity_low_watermark.description: Available identities of an endpoint group dropped below its low watermark.

proxy_low_watermark.label: Proxies below low watermark
proxy_low_watermark.description: Available proxies of a site dropped below the low watermark.

ban_spike.label: Ban spike
ban_spike.description: Identities are being banned much faster than usual.

report_backlog.label: Report backlog
report_backlog.description: Node reports are piling up faster than workers process them.

unknown_ratio_high.label: High unknown ratio
unknown_ratio_high.description: Too many reports match no signal rule; rules may need to be extended.

identity_expired.label: Identity expired
identity_expired.description: Identities expired and need their payload refreshed.

test.label: Test
test.description: Test deliveries sent from the console.

channels.emptyDescription: Add a webhook, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom or Telegram channel to receive alerts.
channels.deleteDescription: Alerts are no longer delivered through this channel. Its delivery history stays in the alert history.

form.description: Choose where alerts are delivered and which alerts are sent.
form.minSeverityHint: Alerts below this severity are not sent.
form.sitesHint: Leave empty to receive alerts of every site.
form.tenantSites: Tenant-wide channels receive alerts of every namespace and site.

config.headersHint: Extra HTTP headers. Values of credential headers (Authorization, tokens, keys) are masked after saving and kept unless replaced entirely.

webhook.url: Receives a JSON POST per alert.
webhook.secret: When set, requests carry X-Spinneret-Timestamp and an HMAC-SHA256 X-Spinneret-Signature.

feishu.webhookUrl: Custom bot webhook of the Feishu group.
feishu.secret: Signature verification secret of the bot, if enabled.

dingtalk.secret: Signing secret (SEC…) of the robot, if enabled.

telegram.chatId: User, group or channel ID the bot posts to.

masked.replaceHint: The stored value is kept unless you replace it.

picker.sitesManual: Type site names and press Enter

validation.eventTypes: Select at least one event type

config.url: Enter an absolute http or https URL
config.botToken: The bot token must look like <bot id>:<secret>
config.masked: This value is masked; replace it entirely or keep the current value
config.maskedDestination: The API base changed: enter the full bot token again
config.headerName: Header names may contain letters, digits and !#$%&'*+.^_`|~-
config.headerReserved: This header is set by Spinneret and cannot be overridden
config.headerMasked: A masked header value was changed; enter the full value
config.headerMaskedDestination: The URL changed: enter the full values of masked credential headers again

alerts.title: Alert
alerts.emptyDescription: Alerts appear here when they fire, with the delivery result of every channel.
